name: dwg-viewer
description: Open-source DWG viewer for VS Code

scripts.check: pnpm run check:release-channel && pnpm run check:adapter-package && pnpm run check:viewport-layer-overrides && pnpm run check:viewer-package-archive && pnpm run check:vsix-archive && pnpm run check:wasm-probe && pnpm run check:korean-corpus && pnpm run check:windows-qualification && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-render-protocol check && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-core check && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-ui check && pnpm --filter @menaje/dwg-scene-source check && pnpm --filter @dwg-viewer/native-document-adapter check && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-webgl check && pnpm --filter dwg-viewer-libredwg check && pnpm --filter dwg-viewer-vscode check && pnpm run qualify:viewer-boundary
scripts.check:release-channel: node --check scripts/release-channel.mjs && node --check scripts/check-marketplace-version.mjs && node --check scripts/create-engine-catalog.mjs && node --test scripts/release-channel.test.mjs scripts/check-marketplace-version.test.mjs scripts/create-engine-catalog.test.mjs
scripts.check:korean-corpus: node --check benchmarks/korean-corpus.mjs && node --check benchmarks/korean-corpus-inventory.mjs && node --check benchmarks/public-korean-corpus.mjs && node --test benchmarks/korean-corpus.test.mjs benchmarks/korean-corpus-inventory.test.mjs benchmarks/public-korean-corpus.test.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run check:release-channel && pnpm run check:adapter-package && pnpm run check:viewport-layer-overrides && pnpm run check:viewer-package-archive && pnpm run check:vsix-archive && pnpm run check:wasm-probe && pnpm run check:korean-corpus && cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-render-protocol test && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-core test && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-ui test && pnpm --filter @menaje/dwg-scene-source test && pnpm --filter @dwg-viewer/native-document-adapter test && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-webgl test && pnpm --filter dwg-viewer-libredwg test && pnpm --filter dwg-viewer-vscode test
scripts.test:viewer-contracts: pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-render-protocol test && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-core test && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-ui test && pnpm --filter @menaje/dwg-scene-source test && pnpm --filter @menaje/viewer-webgl test
